milestones.description: Pre-season complete. Squad of 36 senior players catalogued. Eight loan players (Revan, Coady, Ashfield, Lee, Cannon, Mullin, Hardie, Faal) returned to parent clubs. Youth Academy formalised with 6 players. Board mandate: automatic promotion to Premier League.
Season hub and match journal system initialized. Squad of 36 fully catalogued.
